title: Texas Tech 51, Oklahoma 48: The 2022 Lubbock Overtime Loss
question: What was the score of Oklahoma's overtime game at Texas Tech on November 26, 2022?
answer: Texas Tech beat Oklahoma 51-48 in overtime in Lubbock on November 26, 2022, after trailing by as many as 18 points. The loss ended Oklahoma's regular season at 6-6 and snapped a 10-game Sooner winning streak in the series.
summary: On November 26, 2022, Oklahoma led Texas Tech 24-6 but lost 51-48 in overtime in Lubbock, ending a 10-game win streak in the series.
body: Oklahoma closed its 2022 regular season on November 26 in Lubbock, and the Sooners looked ready to end a tough year on a high note. Quarterback Dillon Gabriel hit Marvin Mims for a 37-yard touchdown to open the scoring, then found Brayden Willis from seven yards out to make it 14-0.

A 77-yard touchdown connection between Gabriel and Mims pushed the lead to 24-6, the biggest cushion Oklahoma would have. Texas Tech answered with touchdown runs by SaRodorick Thompson and Donovan Smith, and a Trey Wolff field goal before halftime made it 24-23 Sooners.

The second half stayed tight. Oklahoma's Zach Schmit kicked a 43-yard field goal late in the fourth quarter to break a tie, but Wolff answered in the final seconds of regulation with a 43-yarder of his own after his first try was blocked and Oklahoma had called a timeout. In overtime, Oklahoma's Schmit missed from 34 yards, and Wolff then won it from 35 yards.

The 51-48 final ended a 10-game Oklahoma winning streak against the Red Raiders. Texas Tech finished 7-5 overall and 5-4 in the Big 12, and the win meant the Red Raiders had beaten both Oklahoma and Texas in the same season. Oklahoma ended the regular season 6-6 overall and 3-6 in the Big 12, then lost the Cheez-It Bowl to Florida State.
